node:sessions.row.runner_unknown: Shown in place of the runner name when the thread's runner is not known.
node:sessions.row.save_name: Icon-button tooltip: save the thread's new name.
node:sessions.row.view_handoff: Icon-button tooltip on a thread row: open its handoff file.
node:sessions.row.write_scope: Short label on a thread row. {{writeCount}} is the number of nodes in the thread's write scope.
node:sessions.row.write_scope_title: Tooltip on the write-scope count of a thread.
server:sample.message: Sample message from the i18n foundation (#528), replaced when the namespace gets real texts. {{userName}}: a name from the data, never translated.
settings:access_requests.list.approving: Button label while an approve/deny request is in flight; an ellipsis only.
settings:access_requests.panel.descripti: “On request” is the node access mode name; it must match node:access.mode.request.label.
settings:access_requests.request.already: The server says the user can already see the node; 'detail' is the node detail pane.
settings:access_requests.request.cancel_: Tooltip of the icon button that closes the inline request form.
Table column header: the date the app was connected. Rendered in uppercase by CSS.
settings:account.connected_apps.disconne: Confirmation dialog. {{appName}}: the OAuth client's name (e.g. Claude), from the data, never translated.
settings:account.connected_apps.empty: claude.ai and Claude Code are product names, never translated.
settings:account.error_box.dismiss: Button that dismisses an error message.
settings:account.not_configured.body: server_url and google_client_id are config.json keys, never translated. Followed by the config file path on its own line.
settings:account.title: Section heading in Settings; rendered in uppercase by CSS.
settings:account.tokens.columns.created: Table column header: the date the token was created. Rendered in uppercase by CSS.
settings:account.tokens.columns.expires: Table column header: the token's expiry date. Rendered in uppercase by CSS.
settings:account.tokens.label_placeholde: Input placeholder; dev-laptop is an example value, not translated.
settings:account.tokens.revoke.confirm: Confirmation dialog. {{tokenLabel}}: the token name the user entered, never translated.
settings:account.tokens.revoke.title: Tooltip of the Revoke button.
settings:account.tokens.status.active: Token status in a table cell.
settings:account.tokens.status.revoked: Token status in a table cell (masculine in Czech, agrees with 'token').
settings:account.user.role: Label followed by the user's scope tier (read/write/manage/admin), which is not translated.
settings:account.user.sign_out: Button that signs the user out of the central server.
settings:account.workspace_kind.label: Label followed by the workspace type value (account.workspaceKind.team / .personal) and, for a team workspace, the server URL in parentheses.
settings:account.workspace_kind.personal: Value after 'Workspace type:' for a personal workspace (data_mode local). Lower case, standalone adjective/noun.
settings:account.workspace_kind.team: Value after 'Workspace type:' for a team workspace (data_mode central). Lower case, standalone adjective/noun.
settings:actors.modal.name_placeholder_a: Example automation name shown as an input placeholder.
settings:actors.modal.name_placeholder_p: Example person name shown as an input placeholder; use a typical local sample name.
settings:actors.modal.user_unknown: Select option for a linked user id that is not in the user list. {{userId}} is the raw user id, never translated.
settings:actors.page.delete: Tooltip on the delete (archive) icon button in an actor row.
settings:actors.placeholder_filter.place: Filter option: show only placeholder (stand-in) actors.
settings:actors.placeholder_filter.real: Filter option: show only real (non-placeholder) actors.
settings:actors.status.placeholder: Status of a stand-in person actor that will later be replaced by a real one.
settings:mcp.actions.install_claude: Button; the path in parentheses is a file path, never translated.
settings:mcp.actions.install_codex: Button; the path in parentheses is a file path, never translated.
settings:mcp.actions.install_vibe: Button; the path in parentheses is a file path, never translated.
settings:mcp.central_note.with_url: Team workspace only. {{serverUrl}} is the central server URL, never translated. 'Front door' is the local MCP endpoint of the sync agent on this device. 'Account' refers to the Account settings section.
settings:mcp.central_note.without_url: Team workspace only, when the central server URL is unknown. 'Front door' is the local MCP endpoint of the sync agent on this device.
settings:mcp.env_hint.body: {{agent}} is a product name (Codex or Vibe), never translated. Keep file names like config.toml and ~/.zshrc as they are.
settings:mcp.env_hint.copy_export: Tooltip of the button that copies the shell 'export PORTUNI_MCP_TOKEN=…' line.
settings:mcp.env_hint.dismiss: Button that hides the post-install hint.
settings:mcp.env_hint.written: Heading of the post-install hint. {{path}} is a config file path, never translated.
settings:mcp.fields.no_auth: Shown in the token field when the server runs without a bearer token.
settings:mcp.fields.token: Row label next to the bearer token field.
settings:mcp.fields.url: Row label next to the MCP server URL.
settings:mcp.flash.copy_failed: {{error}} is an already localized error message.
settings:mcp.flash.install_failed: {{error}} is an already localized error message; install of an MCP config failed.
settings:mcp.flash.install_written: {{path}} is a config file path, never translated.
settings:mcp.flash.regenerate_failed: {{error}} is an already localized error message; token rotation failed.
settings:mcp.flash.token_load_failed: {{error}} is an already localized error message.
settings:mcp.status.unavailable: {{reason}} is a technical reason (HTTP status, error text or settings:mcp.status.noPort); shown as-is in monospace.
settings:mcp.title: Section heading on the Settings page; MCP is a protocol name, not translated.
settings:page.integrations.showtime.desc: … wraps the file extension .showtime, never translated. “Open in Showtime” quotes the preview's button label. Showtime is a product name.
settings:page.integrations.showtime.labe: Product name of a third-party app (Showtime); never translated.
settings:page.integrations.showtime.not_: /Applications and ~/Applications are macOS folder paths; never translated.
settings:page.tabs.workspaces: Tab label; 'workspace' is a glossary term kept in English in Czech too.
settings:runners.create.env_label: KEY=value describes the line format; KEY and value may be translated, the = stays.
settings:runners.create.env_placeholder: Example input; keep CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR= literal, the path may be localized.
settings:runners.create.name_placeholder: Example instance name (e.g. a work account); any short name works.
settings:runners.create.runner_required: claude is a runner id; never translated.
settings:runners.detected.badge_ready: Status badge on a runner row: installed and signed in. Lowercase, short.
settings:runners.detected.badge_unavaila: Status badge on a runner row: not installed or not signed in. Lowercase, short.
settings:runners.detected.not_signed_in: {{runner}} is the runner id (e.g. claude, codex); never translated.
settings:runners.detected.title: Section heading in Settings: the list of runner CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, ...) detected on this device.
settings:runners.env_keys.portuni_key: {{key}} is the environment variable name the user typed; never translated. PORTUNI_* stays literal.
settings:runners.env_keys.secret_shaped: {{key}} is the environment variable name the user typed; never translated. The *_TOKEN/... patterns stay literal.
settings:runners.instances.intro: … wraps a literal environment variable example; keep the tags and the text inside unchanged.
settings:runners.org_defaults.none: Select option: no default instance for this organization.
settings:runners.org_defaults.select_ari: Screen reader label of a select; {{orgName}} is the organization node's name, never translated.
settings:runners.row.cancel_delete: Cancels the pending delete confirmation of an instance.
settings:runners.row.cancel_edit: Cancels the inline edit of an instance.
settings:runners.row.confirm_delete: Second click of a two-step delete button on an instance row.
settings:runners.row.env_key_set: {{key}} is an environment variable name (e.g. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), never translated. Marks that the key has a stored value that is not shown.
settings:runners.row.env_label: KEY=value describes the line format; KEY and value may be translated, the = stays.
settings:runners.row.env_placeholder: Example input; keep CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR= literal, the path may be localized.
settings:runners.row.env_summary: {{keys}} is a comma-separated list of environment variable names, never translated.
settings:sample.message: Sample message from the i18n foundation (#528), replaced when the namespace gets real texts. {{workspaceName}}: a name from the data, never translated.
settings:update.last_checked: {{when}} is an already formatted date and time of the last update check.
settings:update.restart: Button that restarts the desktop app to finish installing an update.
settings:update.status.available: {{version}} is the version number of the release available for download; never translated.
settings:update.status.downloading_pct: {{pct}} is the download progress as a whole number 0-100.
settings:update.version: {{version}} is the installed app version number, e.g. 0.42.1; never translated.
settings:users.columns.role: Column with the user's scope tier (read/write/manage/admin, shown raw).
settings:users.invite.placeholder: Example email address shown in the invite input; keep a syntactically valid address.
settings:users.none: Shown in a table cell when the value is missing (no role, never signed in).
settings:workspaces.create.id_hint: {{id}}: the workspace ID slug derived from the typed name, never translated. <mono> wraps it in a monospace span.
settings:workspaces.create.id_hint_inval: Shown when the typed name yields no valid ID; <mono> wraps the '(invalid)' marker in a monospace span.
settings:workspaces.create.kind_aria_lab: Accessible name of the personal/team radio group.
settings:workspaces.create.name_placehol: Example workspace name in the input placeholder.
settings:workspaces.create.submit_busy: Submit button text while the workspace is being created.
settings:workspaces.create.workspace_roo: Label of the folder where the workspace's mirrors live.
settings:workspaces.list.badge_active: Badge next to a workspace name: this is the active workspace.
settings:workspaces.list.badge_window_op: Badge next to a workspace name: the workspace currently has an open window.
settings:workspaces.list.cancel_delete: Row button: cancels the armed delete.
settings:workspaces.list.col_kind: Table column header: personal or team workspace.
settings:workspaces.list.confirm_delete: Row button: second step, actually deletes the workspace.
settings:workspaces.list.delete: Row button: first step of deleting a workspace; swaps to the confirm button.
settings:workspaces.list.disable: Row button: disable the workspace (stops its sidecar).
settings:workspaces.list.dismiss_error: Button that dismisses an error banner above the workspace table.
settings:workspaces.list.enable: Row button: enable a disabled workspace.
settings:workspaces.list.kind_personal: Cell value in the Type column for a personal workspace (data_mode local).
settings:workspaces.list.kind_team: Cell value in the Type column for a team workspace (data_mode central).
settings:workspaces.list.open: Row button: open the workspace's window.
settings:workspaces.list.status_awaiting: Status cell: the sidecar start is deferred until the user signs in.
settings:workspaces.list.status_disabled: Status cell: the workspace is disabled (adjective describing the workspace).
settings:workspaces.list.status_running: Status cell: the workspace's sidecar is running.
settings:workspaces.list.status_stopped: Status cell: workspace enabled but its sidecar is not running.
settings:workspaces.list.title: Section heading of the desktop-only Settings > Workspaces tab (rendered uppercase by CSS).
